b: With Portugal's intensifying housing crisis sparking major protests and encampments – and police brutality – the country’s music scene has become intertwined with the movement. April Clare Welsh speaks to some of the musicians at its centre and rounds up six key tracks
Maria Reis performs for Portuguese protesters, photo by André Velez Cruz

For over six weeks, protesters across Portugal have been demonstrating against an intensifying housing and affordability crisis, with rents in Lisbon – currently Europe’s least affordable capital for residents – up by 94% and house prices up by 186% since 2015.
